title: U.S. Soldiers demonstrate resiliency during Exercise Masurian Patrol in Poland
summary: A U.S. Army eight-man team assigned to Charlie Company, 2nd Battalion, 37th Armored Regiment competed in a British Patrol Competition from Sept. 1 to 3.. Teams gathered to begin the two-day Exercise Masurian Patrol at the Bemowo Piskie Training Area in Poland. The exercise was named for the Masurian region, where the training area is located. The British-run competition is based on Exercise Cambrian Patrol, which normally takes place in the rugged Cambrian Mountains and swampland of mid-Wales.
